description.en: The player experiences neck pain, stiffness, fatigue or restricted cervical movement during or after tennis. This profile adjusts equipment recommendations to reduce unnecessary upper-body load and repeated strain.
description.zh: 球员在网球运动过程中或结束后出现颈部疼痛、僵硬、疲劳或颈椎活动受限。本画像用于调整装备推荐，以降低上半身不必要的负荷与重复性压力。

equipment_strategy.primary_goal: Reduce Upper-Body Load While Preserving Stable And Predictable Performance

recommended_hybrids: Natural Gut Main + Soft Polyester Cross

avoid: Demanding frames requiring repeated maximal acceleration
Very stiff frames when discomfort is significant

notes: Lower stringbed stiffness may reduce harsh impact feedback transmitted through the upper kinetic chain.
Do not use tension reduction as the only solution if racquet weight or swingweight is clearly excessive.
String material should be reviewed before large tension changes are made.

logic.need_more_comfort: Prefer a softer construction before changing gauge aggressively.
logic.need_more_easy_power: A slightly thinner gauge may be considered when durability allows.

equipment_objectives: Preserve stable response without excessive swingweight

principle.en: Serving and overhead strokes combine repeated upper-body rotation, elevation and racquet acceleration. Excessive racquet demand can increase cumulative fatigue.
principle.zh: 发球与高压球需要重复进行上半身旋转、抬举以及球拍加速，过高的装备负担可能增加累计疲劳。

principle.en: Neck and upper-body symptoms should be considered within the complete kinetic chain rather than attributed to one equipment variable.
principle.zh: 颈部及上半身症状应结合完整动力链进行判断，而不能简单归因于某一个装备变量。

equipment_response: Check shoulder sensitivity when neck symptoms are reported.
Check swingweight and static weight before assuming string stiffness is the primary issue.
Avoid adding racquet mass to solve performance problems without considering cumulative upper-body demand.

recommendation: Avoid equipment requiring repeated maximal acceleration
hard_constraints: Avoid very heavy racquets solely for stability or power.
Do not allow performance goals to override significant physical limitation.

resolution: Increase power through string elasticity and racquet efficiency before adding racquet mass.
Seek torsional stability without excessive swingweight.
Use string geometry and manageable racquet-head acceleration rather than increasing physical demand.
Improve predictability through string selection before moving to a much heavier control frame.

future_recovery_module.routing_rule: This profile identifies equipment implications only. Exercise, rehabilitation, manual therapy or return-to-play recommendations should be handled by a separate recovery module.

message.en: Equipment changes may reduce upper-body loading but cannot diagnose or treat neck conditions. Persistent pain, neurological symptoms, significant weakness or worsening symptoms should be evaluated by an appropriate healthcare professional.
message.zh: 装备调整可能降低上半身负荷，但不能诊断或治疗颈部疾病。如果疼痛持续，或出现神经症状、明显无力或症状不断加重，应由专业医疗人员进行评估。

tradeoffs.acceptable_tradeoff: Reducing unnecessary upper-body loading takes priority over maximizing racquet mass or a single performance characteristic.

must_explain: How neck sensitivity changes the equipment recommendation.
Whether swingweight, static weight, balance or stringbed stiffness is the primary equipment concern.
Why easier racquet acceleration is being prioritized.
What performance compromise is intentionally accepted.
Whether a recovery-module assessment should be considered.
must_not_do: Do not diagnose the cause of neck pain.
Do not prescribe rehabilitation exercises from this equipment profile.
Do not assume every neck-sensitive player needs the lightest racquet possible.
Do not sacrifice racquet stability excessively in pursuit of maneuverability.
